en: Overclocked Death Engine (+10% Chaos per Death Engine)

keys: Wartithe (25% of Income as Mana Shield)
en: Wartithe (25% of Income as Mana Shield)

keys: click a card or press [1-8] to buy  ·  refreshes every round (30s)  ·  buy as many as you can afford
en: click a card or press [1-8] to buy  ·  refreshes every round (30s)  ·  buy as many as you can afford
zh_CN: 点击卡牌或按 [1-8] 购买  ·  每轮刷新（30秒）·  能买多少买多少

keys: MULTI-ARENA NET VIEW  —  %d sharded sims · 1 authoritative director · server tick %d · alive %d/%d  [%s]
en: MULTI-ARENA NET VIEW  —  %d sharded sims · 1 authoritative director · server tick %d · alive %d/%d  [%s]
zh_CN: 多竞技场网络视图  —  %d 分片模拟 · 1 权威裁定器 · 服务器帧 %d · 存活 %d/%d  [%s]

keys: Need at least 1 other player to start.
en: Need at least 1 other player to start.
zh_CN: 至少需要 1 名其他玩家才能开始。

keys: Not everyone is ready yet. [R] readies all.
en: Not everyone is ready yet. [R] readies all.
zh_CN: 还有人未准备好。[R] 一键全部准备。

keys: Start rejected: not all players ready.
en: Start rejected: not all players ready.
zh_CN: 开始失败：并非所有玩家已准备就绪。
开始失败：玩家人数不足。
开始失败：对局已经开始。

keys: [Space] your ready   [A] add player   [X] remove player   [R] ready all   [Enter] start   [T] theme   [Esc] back
en: [Space] your ready   [A] add player   [X] remove player   [R] ready all   [Enter] start   [T] theme   [Esc] back
zh_CN: [Space] 切换准备   [A] 添加玩家   [X] 移除玩家   [R] 全部准备   [Enter] 开始   [T] 主题   [Esc] 返回

keys: Your tank's bot will honor the rule — clear it to unlock the reward skin.   [↑/↓] move   [Enter] deploy   [C/Esc] back
en: Your tank's bot will honor the rule — clear it to unlock the reward skin.   [↑/↓] move   [Enter] deploy   [C/Esc] back
zh_CN: 机器人将遵守规则出战——完成挑战即可解锁奖励皮肤。   [↑/↓] 移动   [Enter] 出战   [C/Esc] 返回

keys: No rule — just deploy with your selected skin.
en: No rule — just deploy with your selected skin.
zh_CN: 无规则限制——直接以当前皮肤出战。

keys: Unlock skins via achievements — purist runs (one weapon type), no-economy, and more.   [arrows] move   [Enter] play   [C] challenges   [L] lobby   [M] net demo   [T] theme   [U] dev-unlock
en: Unlock skins via achievements — purist runs (one weapon type), no-economy, and more.   [arrows] move   [Enter] play   [C] challenges   [L] lobby   [M] net demo   [T] theme   [U] dev-unlock
zh_CN: 通过成就解锁皮肤——纯粹流（单一武器类型）、无经济流等。   [方向键] 移动   [Enter] 出战   [C] 挑战   [L] 大厅   [M] 网络演示   [T] 主题   [U] 开发解锁

keys: The default defender: a dug-in crab-keep (war-tortoise alt skin).
en: The default defender: a dug-in crab-keep (war-tortoise alt skin).
zh_CN: 默认防守者：一座壕沟蟹堡（战龟别皮）。

keys: A bit of every weapon type.
en: A bit of every weapon type.

zh_CN: 只购买单体武器（3件以上）。
只购买溅射武器（3件以上）。
只购买连射武器（3件以上）。
只购买范围武器（3件以上）。
只购买波浪武器（3件以上）。
只购买弹射武器（3件以上）。

keys: Buy 6 weapons with zero income purchases.
en: Buy 6 weapons with zero income purchases.
zh_CN: 在零收入购买的情况下购买 6 件武器。

keys: Buy a weapon of every attack type.
en: Buy a weapon of every attack type.
zh_CN: 每种攻击类型各买一件武器。
在一局中造成 1000000 点伤害。
在一局中赚取 500000 金币。
赢得对局（最后一辆坦克存活）。
机器人只购买单体武器。
机器人只购买溅射武器。
机器人只购买连射武器。
机器人只购买范围武器。
机器人只购买波浪武器。
机器人只购买弹射武器。

keys: Bot never buys income only weapons.
en: Bot never buys income only weapons.
zh_CN: 机器人从不购买收入，只购买武器。

keys: Bot collects a weapon of every type.
en: Bot collects a weapon of every type.
zh_CN: 机器人收集每种类型的武器。

keys: Warden issue, third pattern; the stock is notched once for every gunner the Pale Wardens lost holding this same dirt.
en: Warden issue, third pattern; the stock is notched once for every gunner the Pale Wardens lost holding this same dirt.
zh_CN: 卫士制式，第三型号；枪托上每刻一道，就是苍白卫士为守住这片烂泥而倒下的一名射手。

keys: Single-target piercing. The first thing they hand you, and often the last.
en: Single-target piercing. The first thing they hand you, and often the last.
zh_CN: 单体穿刺。他们最先塞给你的家伙，往往也是你最后摸到的。

keys: Ninth Foundry overrun, its sights still ground for a wall that no longer stands at Ashmark.
en: Ninth Foundry overrun, its sights still ground for a wall that no longer stands at Ashmark.
zh_CN: 第九铸造厂的过剩品，瞄具至今仍校准着艾什马克一堵早已不复存在的城墙。

keys: Lobbed siege splash. Wide blast, slow to reseat.
en: Lobbed siege splash. Wide blast, slow to reseat.
zh_CN: 抛射攻城溅射。爆炸范围大，再装填缓慢。

keys: The cold it throws is the same cold that took Ashmark in one night; the Hexwrights only learned to aim it afterward.
en: The cold it throws is the same cold that took Ashmark in one night; the Hexwrights only learned to aim it afterward.
zh_CN: 它喷出的寒意，正是一夜吞没艾什马克的那股寒意；符文匠不过是事后才学会瞄准它。

keys: Fast single-target magic. Stacks frost toward the freeze.
en: Fast single-target magic. Stacks frost toward the freeze.
zh_CN: 快速单体魔法。叠加冰霜直至冻结。

keys: Greycoat field-rations went bad in the same crates that carried these tips, and the quartermaster shipped both anyway.
en: Greycoat field-rations went bad in the same crates that carried these tips, and the quartermaster shipped both anyway.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵的野战口粮和这些箭头装在同一批箱子里一起变了质，军需官照样把两样都发了下去。

keys: Single-target piercing. Light hit, heavy poison rot.
en: Single-target piercing. Light hit, heavy poison rot.
zh_CN: 单体穿刺。伤害轻，中毒腐蚀重。

keys: Foundry-work turned outward; the men who pour the cannon learned long ago that fire spreads down a packed column.
en: Foundry-work turned outward; the men who pour the cannon learned long ago that fire spreads down a packed column.
zh_CN: 铸造厂的手艺反向施为；浇铸火炮的人早就懂得，火焰会顺着密集的纵队一路蔓延。

keys: Short-range chaos splash. Stacks fire that cooks, then bursts on death.
en: Short-range chaos splash. Stacks fire that cooks, then bursts on death.
zh_CN: 近程混沌溅射。叠加灼烧火焰，目标死亡时引爆。

keys: The Hexwrights bound a storm into the head and never told the Wardens how to put it down.
en: The Hexwrights bound a storm into the head and never told the Wardens how to put it down.
zh_CN: 符文匠把一场风暴封进了弹头，却从没告诉卫士该怎么把它按下去。

keys: Heavy single-target magic. Long stun on the target.
en: Heavy single-target magic. Long stun on the target.
zh_CN: 重型单体魔法。对目标造成长时间眩晕。

keys: Stamped at the Ninth Foundry, four-bolt pattern, built for a frontier that needed walls cleared faster than it had men.
en: Stamped at the Ninth Foundry, four-bolt pattern, built for a frontier that needed walls cleared faster than it had men.
zh_CN: 第九铸造厂出品，四发型号，为一条城墙清得比补兵还快的边境线而造。

keys: Long-range siege barrage. Four bolts to four targets.
en: Long-range siege barrage. Four bolts to four targets.
zh_CN: 远程攻城齐射。四发弹射向四个目标。

keys: Wardens who stood too long beside a failing reactor learned to wear the burn; this makes a weapon of it.
en: Wardens who stood too long beside a failing reactor learned to wear the burn; this makes a weapon of it.
zh_CN: 在故障反应堆旁站得太久的卫士学会了把灼伤穿在身上；而这件东西把灼伤变成了武器。

keys: Chaos area pulse around the tank. Stacks fire on everything near.
en: Chaos area pulse around the tank. Stacks fire on everything near.
zh_CN: 坦克周身的混沌范围脉冲。对附近一切叠加火焰。

keys: Salvaged off the Ashmark sappers, who swung once and let the ground carry the rest of the argument.
en: Salvaged off the Ashmark sappers, who swung once and let the ground carry the rest of the argument.
zh_CN: 从艾什马克的工兵身上扒来的——他们只挥一下，剩下的道理交给大地去讲。

keys: Point-blank normal wave. Big sweeping hit, nothing applied.
en: Point-blank normal wave. Big sweeping hit, nothing applied.
zh_CN: 贴脸普通波。大范围横扫，无附加效果。

keys: A Hexwright trinket that does its own targeting; the Conclave swears it was never meant to leave the vault.
en: A Hexwright trinket that does its own targeting; the Conclave swears it was never meant to leave the vault.
zh_CN: 一件会自己锁定目标的符文匠小玩意；议政会发誓它本不该流出地库。

keys: Single-target piercing chain. Bounces to four enemies.
en: Single-target piercing chain. Bounces to four enemies.
zh_CN: 单体穿刺连锁。弹射至四名敌人。

keys: The Foundry built one and then could not stop building it; each copy makes the next cheaper to feed.
en: The Foundry built one and then could not stop building it; each copy makes the next cheaper to feed.
zh_CN: 铸造厂造出一台后便停不下来；每多一台，下一台的供养就更便宜。

keys: Single-target chaos. Damage compounds per Death Engine owned.
en: Single-target chaos. Damage compounds per Death Engine owned.
zh_CN: 单体混沌。每拥有一台死亡引擎，伤害叠乘增长。

keys: First rite the Conclave teaches its apprentices, and the last thing a great many things ever saw.
en: First rite the Conclave teaches its apprentices, and the last thing a great many things ever saw.
zh_CN: 议政会教给学徒的第一道仪式，也是许许多多东西见到的最后一幕。

keys: Single-target magic. Plain bolt, no status.
en: Single-target magic. Plain bolt, no status.
zh_CN: 单体魔法。普通弹，无状态。

keys: A rock the Greycoats no longer had to carry, thrown at a problem they no longer had to name.
en: A rock the Greycoats no longer had to carry, thrown at a problem they no longer had to name.
zh_CN: 一块灰袍兵再不必背着的石头，砸向一个他们再不必叫出名字的麻烦。

keys: Single-target siege. Heavy stone, no status.
en: Single-target siege. Heavy stone, no status.

keys: Conclave-cut and clean, with none of the frost or fire the Hexwrights add when they want to be remembered.
en: Conclave-cut and clean, with none of the frost or fire the Hexwrights add when they want to be remembered.
zh_CN: 议政会切削得干净利落，没有符文匠想被记住时添上的那些冰霜与火焰。
单体魔法。快速、朴素的一击。

keys: Whatever the Conclave sealed in here predates the war, and it leaves armor unconvinced.
en: Whatever the Conclave sealed in here predates the war, and it leaves armor unconvinced.
zh_CN: 议政会封在里头的东西，比这场战争还古老，护甲对它毫无说服力。
单体混沌。无视护甲类型。

keys: Greycoat sidearms, three to a belt, meant for the work that happens after the line already broke.
en: Greycoat sidearms, three to a belt, meant for the work that happens after the line already broke.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵的副武器，一条腰带挂三把，专为防线已破之后的活计而备。

keys: Short-range piercing chain. Fast, bounces to three.
en: Short-range piercing chain. Fast, bounces to three.
zh_CN: 近程穿刺连锁。快速，弹射至三人。

keys: The Conclave renders down the heads of its own dead and stuffs them with worse; they remember whose they were.
en: The Conclave renders down the heads of its own dead and stuffs them with worse; they remember whose they were.
zh_CN: 议政会熔炼自家死者的头颅，塞进更糟的东西；它们还记得自己曾属于谁。

keys: Chaos chain. Bounces between three bodies.
en: Chaos chain. Bounces between three bodies.
zh_CN: 混沌连锁。在三具躯体间弹射。

keys: Suckula sleeps all day and feasts all night; every bite it lands comes straight back to you as a little more life.
en: Suckula sleeps all day and feasts all night; every bite it lands comes straight back to you as a little more life.
zh_CN: 吸血鬼整日酣睡、彻夜饕餮；它每咬中一口，都化作一点生命径直回流到你身上。

keys: Heavy point-blank chaos wave. Slow, vampiric on the base item.
en: Heavy point-blank chaos wave. Slow, vampiric on the base item.
zh_CN: 重型贴脸混沌波。缓慢，基础物品自带吸血。

keys: Eight tubes off the Ashmark batteries, recovered from a position that fired this volley once and was overrun anyway.
en: Eight tubes off the Ashmark batteries, recovered from a position that fired this volley once and was overrun anyway.
zh_CN: 从艾什马克炮组上拆下的八管发射器，回收自一处放完这一轮齐射、终究还是被攻破的阵地。

keys: Epic long-range piercing barrage. Eight bolts, each stuns.
en: Epic long-range piercing barrage. Eight bolts, each stuns.
zh_CN: 史诗级远程穿刺齐射。八发弹，每发眩晕。

keys: A Warden glaive cut to find its mark across the open ground command never reinforced.
en: A Warden glaive cut to find its mark across the open ground command never reinforced.
zh_CN: 一柄卫士长刃，磨利了只为越过指挥部从不增援的开阔地，找到它的目标。

keys: Long-range piercing chain. Bounces to three.
en: Long-range piercing chain. Bounces to three.
zh_CN: 远程穿刺连锁。弹射至三人。

keys: Ninth Foundry pressure-rig, the kind that scalds the loader as readily as the target.
en: Ninth Foundry pressure-rig, the kind that scalds the loader as readily as the target.
zh_CN: 第九铸造厂的高压装置，烫起装填手来和烫目标一样利落。

keys: Short-range siege splash. Brief stun on hit.
en: Short-range siege splash. Brief stun on hit.
zh_CN: 近程攻城溅射。命中造成短暂眩晕。

keys: The Conclave does not say where this eye came from, only that it chooses, and the choosing is final.
en: The Conclave does not say where this eye came from, only that it chooses, and the choosing is final.
zh_CN: 议政会不说这只眼睛从何而来，只说它会挑选，而挑选无可更改。

keys: Heavy single-target chaos. Pure punch, no status.
en: Heavy single-target chaos. Pure punch, no status.
zh_CN: 重型单体混沌。纯粹打击，无状态。

keys: Warden spearwork, made for the press at the wire where there is no room to miss.
en: Warden spearwork, made for the press at the wire where there is no room to miss.
zh_CN: 卫士的长矛技艺，为铁丝网前那拥挤得容不下半点失手的近战而生。
快速单体穿刺。短暂眩晕。

keys: A Hexwright cloud of small wrong things, loosed long over the Ashmark dead and quiet after.
en: A Hexwright cloud of small wrong things, loosed long over the Ashmark dead and quiet after.
zh_CN: 符文匠放出的一团细小的歪斜之物，远远撒过艾什马克的死者，过后便归于沉寂。

keys: Long-range chaos splash. Spreads on impact.
en: Long-range chaos splash. Spreads on impact.
zh_CN: 远程混沌溅射。命中时扩散。

keys: Foundry stonework, short-ranged and unsubtle, built for a line that had run out of subtler answers.
en: Foundry stonework, short-ranged and unsubtle, built for a line that had run out of subtler answers.
zh_CN: 铸造厂的投石器，射程短而粗暴，为一条再无精巧之法的防线而造。

keys: One enormous open-palm Slap, delivered with the full indignation of a creature that was having a perfectly nice day.
en: One enormous open-palm Slap, delivered with the full indignation of a creature that was having a perfectly nice day.
zh_CN: 一记巨大的张掌掴击，饱含一只本来今天过得相当不错的生物的全部愤慨。

keys: Epic single-target piercing. Enormous hit, no status.
en: Epic single-target piercing. Enormous hit, no status.
zh_CN: 史诗级单体穿刺。巨额伤害，无状态。

keys: The Greycoats took to calling this one mercy and kept walking; whatever it touches stops being a leg.
en: The Greycoats took to calling this one mercy and kept walking; whatever it touches stops being a leg.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵把这一击叫作仁慈，然后头也不回地走开；它碰过的东西就不再算是条腿了。

keys: Heavy single-target piercing. Lasting wound on the base item.
en: Heavy single-target piercing. Lasting wound on the base item.
zh_CN: 重型单体穿刺。基础物品造成持续性创伤。

keys: A Warden exotic that takes from the wrong end of the wound and gives it back to the gunner.
en: A Warden exotic that takes from the wrong end of the wound and gives it back to the gunner.
zh_CN: 一件卫士奇械，从伤口错误的那一端抽取，再回赠给射手。

keys: Long-range normal single-target. Feeds you on the base item.
en: Long-range normal single-target. Feeds you on the base item.
zh_CN: 远程普通单体。基础物品为你回血。

keys: Conclave-honed thought given an edge, cutting outbound and again on the return.
en: Conclave-honed thought given an edge, cutting outbound and again on the return.
zh_CN: 议政会磨利的念头被赋予锋刃，去时一斩，归途再斩。

keys: No Hexwright trick on this one, just Foundry steel that refuses to lie where it lands.
en: No Hexwright trick on this one, just Foundry steel that refuses to lie where it lands.
zh_CN: 这件没有符文匠的把戏，只是落地后拒绝安分的铸造厂钢铁。

keys: Spikewheel off the Ashmark works, set rolling once and never minded the men behind it.
en: Spikewheel off the Ashmark works, set rolling once and never minded the men behind it.
zh_CN: 从艾什马克工坊出来的尖刺轮，推它滚一回，它便从不在意身后的人。

keys: Long-range siege chain. Bounces through six.
en: Long-range siege chain. Bounces through six.
zh_CN: 远程攻城连锁。穿过六人弹射。

keys: Whatever the Greycoats could not bury, they loaded; the ledger lists it as ammunition.
en: Whatever the Greycoats could not bury, they loaded; the ledger lists it as ammunition.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵埋不掉的东西，就拿来装填；账册上把它登记作弹药。

keys: Normal splash. Heavy impact, brief stun.
en: Normal splash. Heavy impact, brief stun.
zh_CN: 普通溅射。重击，短暂眩晕。

keys: Conclave hardware that discharges clean and leaves the smell on the air longer than the target.
en: Conclave hardware that discharges clean and leaves the smell on the air longer than the target.
zh_CN: 议政会的硬货，放电干净，留在空气里的气味比目标待得还久。

keys: Barbs the Greycoats scavenged off something the Conclave should have burned, each one a small lasting debt.
en: Barbs the Greycoats scavenged off something the Conclave should have burned, each one a small lasting debt.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵从某件议政会本该烧掉的东西上扒下的倒刺，每一根都是一笔持续的小债。
单体穿刺。轻度中毒腐蚀。

keys: A Hexwright thing that lands still living, briefly, and leaves the target the same way.
en: A Hexwright thing that lands still living, briefly, and leaves the target the same way.
zh_CN: 一件符文匠造物，落地时仍短暂地活着，也让目标以同样的方式苟延。

keys: Foundry shell packed over a Greycoat sickness, so the crater goes on killing after the blast is done.
en: Foundry shell packed over a Greycoat sickness, so the crater goes on killing after the blast is done.
zh_CN: 铸造厂的炮弹里裹着灰袍兵的瘟病，于是爆炸过后，弹坑仍在继续杀人。

keys: Siege splash. Poisons the whole crater.
en: Siege splash. Poisons the whole crater.
zh_CN: 攻城溅射。使整个弹坑中毒。

keys: One bite, by a thing the Conclave bred and refuses to account for; the rest is only the waiting.
en: One bite, by a thing the Conclave bred and refuses to account for; the rest is only the waiting.
zh_CN: 议政会培育却拒绝交代的东西，只咬一口；剩下的不过是等待。
单体普通。强力中毒腐蚀。

keys: They told it the safe load at the Ninth Foundry, and the catapult overruled them in stone.
en: They told it the safe load at the Ninth Foundry, and the catapult overruled them in stone.
zh_CN: 第九铸造厂给它定了安全装填量，投石机用石头驳回了他们。

keys: Heavy siege splash. Bigger rock, bigger hole.
en: Heavy siege splash. Bigger rock, bigger hole.
zh_CN: 重型攻城溅射。石头更大，坑更大。

keys: A Conclave reach out of nowhere that closes on whatever the gunner could least spare.
en: A Conclave reach out of nowhere that closes on whatever the gunner could least spare.
zh_CN: 议政会凭空伸出的一只手，攥住射手最输不起的那一处。

keys: Greycoat netting, weighted and thrown, because a thing on the floor counting threads is a thing not at the wire.
en: Greycoat netting, weighted and thrown, because a thing on the floor counting threads is a thing not at the wire.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵的网，坠重抛出，因为一个趴在地上数网线的东西，就不会出现在铁丝网前。

keys: Fast long-range normal single-target. Tangling stun.
en: Fast long-range normal single-target. Tangling stun.
zh_CN: 快速远程普通单体。缠绕眩晕。

keys: The Hexwrights seeded this ground and walked away; what grew has its own opinion about trespass.
en: The Hexwrights seeded this ground and walked away; what grew has its own opinion about trespass.
zh_CN: 符文匠在这片地上播了种便扬长而去；长出来的东西对擅闯自有看法。

keys: Wide piercing area pulse. Hits everything near.
en: Wide piercing area pulse. Hits everything near.
zh_CN: 大范围穿刺范围脉冲。命中附近一切。

keys: A Conclave spirit that died once already and took the lesson badly, loosed to chain through a column.
en: A Conclave spirit that died once already and took the lesson badly, loosed to chain through a column.
zh_CN: 一缕已经死过一次、却没把教训学好的议政会亡魂，被放出来在纵队中连锁穿行。

keys: Epic magic chain. Wails through eight.
en: Epic magic chain. Wails through eight.
zh_CN: 史诗级魔法连锁。哀嚎着穿过八人。

keys: A Hexwright reactor's exhale, a clean white nothing the Wardens learned to point downrange.
en: A Hexwright reactor's exhale, a clean white nothing the Wardens learned to point downrange.
zh_CN: 符文匠反应堆的一口吐息，一片洁白的虚无，卫士学会了把它指向远处。

keys: Point-blank magic wave. Sweeps wide, stuns.
en: Point-blank magic wave. Sweeps wide, stuns.
zh_CN: 贴脸魔法波。大范围横扫，眩晕。

keys: A full rack of Ninth Foundry warheads, every casing serial-stamped and none of them aimed at anyone in particular.
en: A full rack of Ninth Foundry warheads, every casing serial-stamped and none of them aimed at anyone in particular.
zh_CN: 一整架第九铸造厂的弹头，每个弹壳都打了序列号，却没有一个特意瞄准谁。

keys: Long chaos barrage. Twelve warheads to scattered targets, no status.
en: Long chaos barrage. Twelve warheads to scattered targets, no status.
zh_CN: 远程混沌齐射。十二枚弹头射向分散目标，无状态。

keys: The Hexwrights bottled the night Ashmark froze and packed it behind a fuse.
en: The Hexwrights bottled the night Ashmark froze and packed it behind a fuse.
zh_CN: 符文匠把艾什马克冻结的那一夜装进瓶里，封在了引信之后。

keys: Fast piercing splash. Stacks frost on the cluster.
en: Fast piercing splash. Stacks frost on the cluster.
zh_CN: 快速穿刺溅射。对集群叠加冰霜。

keys: A Foundry reject that never machined round, so the Greycoats let it loose to crack heads instead.
en: A Foundry reject that never machined round, so the Greycoats let it loose to crack heads instead.
zh_CN: 一件铸造厂的废品，怎么也车不圆，灰袍兵索性放它出去砸脑袋。

keys: Normal bounce. Four hops, each stuns.
en: Normal bounce. Four hops, each stuns.
zh_CN: 普通弹射。弹跳四次，每次眩晕。

keys: The Pale Wardens cut this from the field after the Relief failed to come, and it has been hungry since.
en: The Pale Wardens cut this from the field after the Relief failed to come, and it has been hungry since.
zh_CN: 援军终未抵达后，苍白卫士从战场上割下了它，自那以后它便一直饥饿。

keys: Epic normal bounce. Chains four; feeds the tank.
en: Epic normal bounce. Chains four; feeds the tank.
zh_CN: 史诗级普通弹射。连锁四人；为坦克回血。

keys: Foundry-town surplus by the crateload, cheap enough that the quartermaster stopped counting them.
en: Foundry-town surplus by the crateload, cheap enough that the quartermaster stopped counting them.
zh_CN: 铸造城镇成箱的剩货，便宜到军需官懒得再清点。

keys: Fast normal splash. Rapid small bursts, no status.
en: Fast normal splash. Rapid small bursts, no status.
zh_CN: 快速普通溅射。急促的小型爆发，无状态。

keys: Warden arrows wrapped in Foundry pitch, lit one rank at a time the way the line always burns.
en: Warden arrows wrapped in Foundry pitch, lit one rank at a time the way the line always burns.
zh_CN: 裹着铸造厂沥青的卫士箭，一排排点燃，正如防线一贯的燃烧方式。

keys: Piercing barrage. Four shots, each stacks fire.
en: Piercing barrage. Four shots, each stacks fire.
zh_CN: 穿刺齐射。四发，每发叠加火焰。

keys: The Conclave strung this between the Ashmark dead and called the rot it leaves a side effect.
en: The Conclave strung this between the Ashmark dead and called the rot it leaves a side effect.
zh_CN: 议政会把它系在艾什马克的死者之间，还把它留下的腐烂称作副作用。

keys: Chaos bounce. Six links; leaves poison.
en: Chaos bounce. Six links; leaves poison.
zh_CN: 混沌弹射。六段连锁；留下中毒。

keys: Hexwright work meant for close quarters, borrowing more power than the gunner can hold.
en: Hexwright work meant for close quarters, borrowing more power than the gunner can hold.
zh_CN: 符文匠为近战打造的活计，借来的力量多过射手所能掌控。
近程魔法弹射。连锁四人。

keys: Ladled straight from a Ninth Foundry crucible and slung before it cools.
en: Ladled straight from a Ninth Foundry crucible and slung before it cools.
zh_CN: 直接从第九铸造厂的坩埚里舀出，趁还没冷却就甩了出去。
快速攻城单体。叠加火焰。

keys: Catapult ammunition the Greycoats stripped from Ashmark's broken walls and lobbed back.
en: Catapult ammunition the Greycoats stripped from Ashmark's broken walls and lobbed back.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵从艾什马克残墙上拆下、再抛回去的投石机弹药。

keys: Short normal splash. Crushing impact, no status.
en: Short normal splash. Crushing impact, no status.
zh_CN: 近程普通溅射。粉碎性撞击，无状态。

keys: The Wardens worked these into the dirt of the last yard the night before they were overrun.
en: The Wardens worked these into the dirt of the last yard the night before they were overrun.
zh_CN: 卫士在阵地被攻破的前一夜，把这些埋进了最后一码土地里。

keys: Epic normal wave. Heavy sweep; stuns.
en: Epic normal wave. Heavy sweep; stuns.
zh_CN: 史诗级普通波。重型横扫；眩晕。

keys: Shroom Doom seeds a whole patch of angry caps; they pop in a chain, and what survives the blast gets up as your Spores.
en: Shroom Doom seeds a whole patch of angry caps; they pop in a chain, and what survives the blast gets up as your Spores.
zh_CN: 蘑菇末日播下一整片暴怒的菌盖；它们连锁爆裂，而从爆炸中幸存的，会作为你的孢子重新站起。

keys: Epic chaos pulse. Massive fire stacks; stuns.
en: Epic chaos pulse. Massive fire stacks; stuns.
zh_CN: 史诗级混沌脉冲。海量火焰叠层；眩晕。

keys: The Ninth Foundry never meant for one furnace to feed a whole field, but the war stopped asking.
en: The Ninth Foundry never meant for one furnace to feed a whole field, but the war stopped asking.
zh_CN: 第九铸造厂从没打算用一座熔炉喂养整片战场，但战争已经懒得征求意见。

keys: Epic magic pulse. Buries a pack in fire stacks.
en: Epic magic pulse. Buries a pack in fire stacks.
zh_CN: 史诗级魔法脉冲。用火焰叠层埋葬一群敌人。

keys: Standard Foundry issue for the front rank, where the line meets the dark and rarely holds.
en: Standard Foundry issue for the front rank, where the line meets the dark and rarely holds.
zh_CN: 前排的铸造厂标准制式，那里防线撞上黑暗，鲜少能守住。
快速穿刺溅射。叠加火焰。

keys: The Foundry-towns tap the deep crucibles for this, and what it spits keeps burning long after Ashmark's example.
en: The Foundry-towns tap the deep crucibles for this, and what it spits keeps burning long after Ashmark's example.
zh_CN: 铸造城镇为它启用了深层坩埚，它喷出的东西在艾什马克的前车之鉴之后仍燃烧不息。

keys: Epic long siege splash. Heavy fire stacks.
en: Epic long siege splash. Heavy fire stacks.
zh_CN: 史诗级远程攻城溅射。重型火焰叠层。

keys: A single sliver of the cold that took Ashmark, fired again and again until something stops.
en: A single sliver of the cold that took Ashmark, fired again and again until something stops.
zh_CN: 吞没艾什马克的那股寒意的一缕碎片，一遍遍发射，直到有什么停下来。
快速穿刺单体。叠加冰霜。

keys: Conclave frost that does not wait to be aimed; it spreads the way the Ashmark winter spread.
en: Conclave frost that does not wait to be aimed; it spreads the way the Ashmark winter spread.
zh_CN: 议政会的寒霜，不等人瞄准；它扩散的方式，就像艾什马克的寒冬扩散一样。

keys: Magic splash. Spreads frost on impact.
en: Magic splash. Spreads frost on impact.
zh_CN: 魔法溅射。命中时扩散冰霜。

keys: The Hexwrights bound a piece of that killing winter to a frame and could never make it stop.
en: The Hexwrights bound a piece of that killing winter to a frame and could never make it stop.
zh_CN: 符文匠把那场杀人寒冬的一角缚进框架，却再也没能让它停下。

keys: Epic magic pulse. Frosts a huge radius toward freeze.
en: Epic magic pulse. Frosts a huge radius toward freeze.
zh_CN: 史诗级魔法脉冲。在巨大范围内叠加冰霜直至冻结。

keys: Ashmark-cold shards racked by the Greycoats, four to a volley, ledgered by the dozen.
en: Ashmark-cold shards racked by the Greycoats, four to a volley, ledgered by the dozen.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵架起的艾什马克寒霜碎片，一轮四发，按打记账。

keys: Normal barrage. Four hits, each stacks frost.
en: Normal barrage. Four hits, each stacks frost.
zh_CN: 普通齐射。四发，每发叠加冰霜。

keys: The first thing the quartermaster hands a green Greycoat, and the cheapest line in the ledger.
en: The first thing the quartermaster hands a green Greycoat, and the cheapest line in the ledger.
zh_CN: 军需官发给菜鸟灰袍兵的第一样东西，也是账册上最便宜的一项。

keys: Fast piercing barrage. Three blades, no status.
en: Fast piercing barrage. Three blades, no status.
zh_CN: 快速穿刺齐射。三片刃，无状态。

keys: Blunt Foundry overrun, loud and serial-stamped, sold by weight to the Wardens.
en: Blunt Foundry overrun, loud and serial-stamped, sold by weight to the Wardens.
zh_CN: 粗钝的铸造厂过剩品，吵闹又打着序列号，按斤卖给卫士。

keys: A Greycoat deserter's rifle, recovered from Ashmark with the scope still sighted on a fleeing back.
en: A Greycoat deserter's rifle, recovered from Ashmark with the scope still sighted on a fleeing back.
zh_CN: 一名灰袍逃兵的步枪，从艾什马克回收时，瞄准镜还对准着一个逃跑的背影。

keys: Fast long normal single-target. No status.
en: Fast long normal single-target. No status.
zh_CN: 快速远程普通单体。无状态。

keys: Ninth Foundry charges that the Greycoats lob underhand and never look back at.
en: Ninth Foundry charges that the Greycoats lob underhand and never look back at.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵低手抛出、绝不回头看一眼的第九铸造厂炸药。
近程攻城溅射。短暂眩晕。

keys: A single precise Sting from a very small, very offended thing — and suddenly the target is taking everyone's hits much harder.
en: A single precise Sting from a very small, very offended thing — and suddenly the target is taking everyone's hits much harder.
zh_CN: 一只极小、极其被冒犯的东西精准地蜇上一针——目标突然就承受起所有人的攻击，痛得多了。

keys: Somebody's skull, packed by the Greycoats with worse and stamped for the line.
en: Somebody's skull, packed by the Greycoats with worse and stamped for the line.
zh_CN: 某人的头骨，被灰袍兵塞进更糟的东西，盖章发往前线。

keys: Foundry casings charged with Ashmark's leftover cold, breathed out across the crater.
en: Foundry casings charged with Ashmark's leftover cold, breathed out across the crater.
zh_CN: 填着艾什马克残留寒意的铸造厂弹壳，把寒气吐遍整个弹坑。
攻城溅射。使爆炸范围结霜。

keys: The Conclave sends the cold out in a line now, the way the news of Ashmark traveled the front.
en: The Conclave sends the cold out in a line now, the way the news of Ashmark traveled the front.
zh_CN: 议政会如今把寒意排成一线放出，就像艾什马克的消息传遍前线的样子。

keys: A wall of Foundry-fire walked forward across the dirt, the way the front rank is supposed to and no longer can.
en: A wall of Foundry-fire walked forward across the dirt, the way the front rank is supposed to and no longer can.
zh_CN: 一堵铸造厂之火砌成的墙在泥地上向前推进，正如前排本该做却再也做不到的那样。

keys: Normal wave. Sweeps; heavy fire stacks.
en: Normal wave. Sweeps; heavy fire stacks.
zh_CN: 普通波。横扫；重型火焰叠层。

keys: A Hexwright spark that flickers out and carries a sliver of the gunner back with each kill.
en: A Hexwright spark that flickers out and carries a sliver of the gunner back with each kill.
zh_CN: 一簇符文匠的火花，熄灭时每杀一个，就带回一缕射手的生机。

keys: Fast chaos single-target. Heals the tank.
en: Fast chaos single-target. Heals the tank.
zh_CN: 快速混沌单体。为坦克回血。

keys: The Conclave taught it to drink an enemy's borrowed power before it spends the enemy.
en: The Conclave taught it to drink an enemy's borrowed power before it spends the enemy.
zh_CN: 议政会教会它在耗尽敌人之前，先喝光敌人借来的力量。

keys: Fast long magic single-target. No status.
en: Fast long magic single-target. No status.
zh_CN: 快速远程魔法单体。无状态。

keys: Squirm keeps a wriggling brood in reserve; every kill it lands hatches another hungry Larva to join the march.
en: Squirm keeps a wriggling brood in reserve; every kill it lands hatches another hungry Larva to join the march.
zh_CN: 蠕虫备着一窝扭动的幼崽；它每杀一个，就孵出又一只饥饿的幼虫加入行进。

keys: Epic long chaos single-target. No status.
en: Epic long chaos single-target. No status.
zh_CN: 史诗级远程混沌单体。无状态。

keys: Warden field-rig that wraps the tank in Foundry heat and makes the burn everyone else's problem.
en: Warden field-rig that wraps the tank in Foundry heat and makes the burn everyone else's problem.
zh_CN: 卫士的野战装置，用铸造厂的高温裹住坦克，把灼烧变成别人的麻烦。

keys: Rapid magic wave. Constant fire near the tank.
en: Rapid magic wave. Constant fire near the tank.
zh_CN: 急速魔法波。坦克附近持续燃烧。

keys: Boom Bloom scatters a tidy little garden of pop-when-touched buds across the last yard, and the front rank finds every one.
en: Boom Bloom scatters a tidy little garden of pop-when-touched buds across the last yard, and the front rank finds every one.
zh_CN: 轰鸣花在最后一码土地上撒下一座整齐的小花园，花蕾一碰即炸，而前排会把每一朵都踩中。

keys: Epic siege wave. Fast, brutal; stuns.
en: Epic siege wave. Fast, brutal; stuns.
zh_CN: 史诗级攻城波。快速、残暴；眩晕。

keys: A Warden quill-rig recovered off Ashmark, sprung once across a whole closing cluster.
en: A Warden quill-rig recovered off Ashmark, sprung once across a whole closing cluster.
zh_CN: 从艾什马克回收的卫士尖刺装置，对一整群逼近的敌人弹射一回。

keys: Long piercing splash. Sprays the cluster, no status.
en: Long piercing splash. Sprays the cluster, no status.
zh_CN: 远程穿刺溅射。喷射整个集群，无状态。

keys: Pure Conclave intention let off all at once, the kind of borrowing the Hexwrights regret in the morning.
en: Pure Conclave intention let off all at once, the kind of borrowing the Hexwrights regret in the morning.
zh_CN: 纯粹的议政会意志一次性倾泻而出，正是那种符文匠到了早上会后悔的借贷。

keys: Long magic splash. Detonates on impact.
en: Long magic splash. Detonates on impact.
zh_CN: 远程魔法溅射。命中即引爆。

keys: The sky pays the Ninth Foundry's debts all at once, then makes the line wait a long time for the next installment.
en: The sky pays the Ninth Foundry's debts all at once, then makes the line wait a long time for the next installment.
zh_CN: 天空一次性偿清第九铸造厂的债，然后让前线为下一期分期苦等许久。

keys: Epic siege barrage. Eight meteors; long reload.
en: Epic siege barrage. Eight meteors; long reload.
zh_CN: 史诗级攻城齐射。八颗陨石；长冷却。

keys: A keg the Greycoats meant for after the Relief came, lit and thrown instead.
en: A keg the Greycoats meant for after the Relief came, lit and thrown instead.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵本想留到援军抵达后再开的一桶酒，结果点着了扔了出去。

keys: Fast siege splash. Heals the tank.
en: Fast siege splash. Heals the tank.
zh_CN: 快速攻城溅射。为坦克回血。

keys: Quick mean Conclave work that goes through armor like it was never logged.
en: Quick mean Conclave work that goes through armor like it was never logged.
zh_CN: 又快又狠的议政会手艺，穿透护甲就像它从未登记在册。

keys: Fast long chaos single-target. Ignores armor types.
en: Fast long chaos single-target. Ignores armor types.
zh_CN: 快速远程混沌单体。无视护甲类型。

keys: Hexwright lightning bound to circle the tank, and standing near it is the gunner's own decision.
en: Hexwright lightning bound to circle the tank, and standing near it is the gunner's own decision.
zh_CN: 符文匠的闪电被缚住绕坦克盘旋，站到它近旁是射手自己的决定。

keys: Wide magic pulse. Shocks everything around.
en: Wide magic pulse. Shocks everything around.
zh_CN: 大范围魔法脉冲。电击周围一切。

keys: The Conclave wired this to hum off the enemy's own borrowed mana, and things near it stop humming.
en: The Conclave wired this to hum off the enemy's own borrowed mana, and things near it stop humming.
zh_CN: 议政会把它接线成靠敌人借来的法力嗡鸣，而它近旁的东西就不再嗡鸣了。

keys: Foundry-fire let off in a bloom, the way the front rank goes when the line finally breaks.
en: Foundry-fire let off in a bloom, the way the front rank goes when the line finally breaks.
zh_CN: 铸造厂之火绽放着释放，正如防线终于崩溃时前排的下场。

keys: Chaos pulse. Erupts fire around the tank.
en: Chaos pulse. Erupts fire around the tank.
zh_CN: 混沌脉冲。在坦克周围喷发火焰。

keys: A Ninth Foundry coil that taps fast enough to leave no gap between the taps.
en: A Ninth Foundry coil that taps fast enough to leave no gap between the taps.
zh_CN: 一具第九铸造厂的线圈，放电快到两次之间不留半点空隙。

keys: Rapid long siege pulse. Near-constant stun-lock.
en: Rapid long siege pulse. Near-constant stun-lock.
zh_CN: 急速远程攻城脉冲。近乎持续的眩晕锁。

keys: Tangle throws out a snarl of sticky vine that pins a thing right where it stands and politely refuses to let go.
en: Tangle throws out a snarl of sticky vine that pins a thing right where it stands and politely refuses to let go.
zh_CN: 缠藤甩出一团黏稠的藤蔓乱结，把目标牢牢钉在原地，再礼貌地拒绝松手。

keys: Fast epic normal single-target. Roots the target in place.
en: Fast epic normal single-target. Roots the target in place.
zh_CN: 快速史诗级普通单体。将目标定身于原地。

keys: Foundry stamps this kit "general issue," the catch-all crate the Wardens hand out when nothing specialized survived the haul from Ashmark.
en: Foundry stamps this kit "general issue," the catch-all crate the Wardens hand out when nothing specialized survived the haul from Ashmark.
zh_CN: 铸造厂把这套装备盖章为"通用制式"——当从艾什马克运来的特种货一样都没剩下时，卫士就发这只大杂烩箱子。

keys: Hexwrights ground these heads to a finer point than the Foundry would risk, and the Wardens never asked how.
en: Hexwrights ground these heads to a finer point than the Foundry would risk, and the Wardens never asked how.
zh_CN: 符文匠把这些箭头磨得比铸造厂敢冒的险还要尖，而卫士从没问过是怎么做到的。
强化穿刺攻击：穿刺伤害 +10%。

keys: Recovered from the Ashmark siege-works, calibrated for walls that fell the night the line broke.
en: Recovered from the Ashmark siege-works, calibrated for walls that fell the night the line broke.
zh_CN: 回收自艾什马克的攻城工事，校准目标是防线崩溃那夜倒下的城墙。
强化攻城攻击：攻城伤害 +10%。

keys: The Conclave bottles a little more of what it borrows, and signs none of it.
en: The Conclave bottles a little more of what it borrows, and signs none of it.
zh_CN: 议政会把借来的东西多装进瓶里一点，却一笔都不签字。
强化魔法攻击：魔法伤害 +10%。

keys: Foundry overrun stamped EPIC and locked in the deep vault; the Wardens were told it would never leave Ashmark.
en: Foundry overrun stamped EPIC and locked in the deep vault; the Wardens were told it would never leave Ashmark.
zh_CN: 铸造厂的过剩品，盖着"史诗"章锁进深层地库；卫士被告知它永远不会离开艾什马克。

keys: A Hexwright governor wired into the firing chain, shaving the pause the Foundry built in for safety.
en: A Hexwright governor wired into the firing chain, shaving the pause the Foundry built in for safety.
zh_CN: 一具接入击发链路的符文匠调速器，削掉了铸造厂为安全预留的那段停顿。

keys: The quartermaster's ledger pays a premium per body, settled out of whatever the Greycoats strip off the field.
en: The quartermaster's ledger pays a premium per body, settled out of whatever the Greycoats strip off the field.
zh_CN: 军需官的账册按尸体加价结算，从灰袍兵在战场上扒来的东西里抵付。
赏金猎人：每次击杀金币 +50%。

keys: A Hexwright-tapped seam that pays the gunner in coin and in mending both, the ledger and the surgeon settled from one vein.
en: A Hexwright-tapped seam that pays the gunner in coin and in mending both, the ledger and the surgeon settled from one vein.
zh_CN: 一道符文匠开掘的矿脉，既以金币也以治愈支付射手，账册与军医从同一条矿脉结清。

keys: Entangled Gold Mine: +20 income, 25% of it healed.
en: Entangled Gold Mine: +20 income, 25% of it healed.
zh_CN: 纠缠金矿：收入 +20，其中 25% 转化为治疗。

keys: The quartermaster skims a margin off every coin the Greycoats turn in, and the ledger never forgets.
en: The quartermaster skims a margin off every coin the Greycoats turn in, and the ledger never forgets.
zh_CN: 军需官从灰袍兵上缴的每一枚金币里揩一层油，账册从不遗忘。

keys: A heavier cut, written into the ledger by a quartermaster who stopped pretending the conscripts would be paid.
en: A heavier cut, written into the ledger by a quartermaster who stopped pretending the conscripts would be paid.
zh_CN: 更狠的一笔抽成，由一位不再假装会给征召兵发饷的军需官写进账册。

keys: The quartermaster keeps a crooked ledger; now and then a body settles for far more than its line was worth, and pays the premium too.
en: The quartermaster keeps a crooked ledger; now and then a body settles for far more than its line was worth, and pays the premium too.
zh_CN: 军需官记着一本歪账；时不时有具尸体结算得远超它那一行该值的价，溢价也一并付清。

keys: Transmute: +100% bounty; 5% of kills pay triple.
en: Transmute: +100% bounty; 5% of kills pay triple.
zh_CN: 嬗变：赏金 +100%；5% 的击杀支付三倍。

keys: Warden masons doubled the wall on the wall they already had, the way a siege teaches you to never stop pouring stone.
en: Warden masons doubled the wall on the wall they already had, the way a siege teaches you to never stop pouring stone.
zh_CN: 卫士的石匠在已有的墙上又砌了一倍的墙，正如围城教会你的：永远别停下浇石。

keys: Foundry hull-shave, rolled too thin in the rush but thick enough to turn what the Relief left you to face.
en: Foundry hull-shave, rolled too thin in the rush but thick enough to turn what the Relief left you to face.
zh_CN: 铸造厂的舱体薄板，赶工时压得太薄，却也够厚，能挡住援军留给你独自面对的东西。
固定护甲 +10。削减每次受击。

keys: A Hexwright spring fed into the hull, the borrowed skin topping itself off the way a well does.
en: A Hexwright spring fed into the hull, the borrowed skin topping itself off the way a well does.
zh_CN: 一眼接入舱体的符文匠泉源，借来的外皮像井水一样自行回满。
月亮井：法力护盾 +2000，持续再生。

keys: The Relief that never came included field-surgeons; the Wardens improvised this drip in their absence.
en: The Relief that never came included field-surgeons; the Wardens improvised this drip in their absence.
zh_CN: 那支始终没来的援军里本该有战地军医；卫士在他们缺席时临时凑出了这套点滴。

keys: A Warden's last trick when the line is held and the Relief is a rumor: be where the blow is not.
en: A Warden's last trick when the line is held and the Relief is a rumor: be where the blow is not.
zh_CN: 当防线还守着、援军只是个传闻时，卫士最后的招数：人不在挨打的地方。

keys: Evasion: +10% chance to dodge a hit.
en: Evasion: +10% chance to dodge a hit.
zh_CN: 闪避：+10% 几率躲开一次攻击。

keys: The longer the war drags on, the heavier the Foundry's old governor leans into the firing chain.
en: The longer the war drags on, the heavier the Foundry's old governor leans into the firing chain.
zh_CN: 战争拖得越久，铸造厂那具老调速器就越用力压向击发链路。

keys: Power Generator: +2% damage now, +1% every round.
en: Power Generator: +2% damage now, +1% every round.
zh_CN: 动力发生器：当前伤害 +2%，每回合 +1%。

keys: The Conclave warned that borrowed chaos compounds with every round it sits unrepaid, and The Hippocrate is still on the horizon.
en: The Conclave warned that borrowed chaos compounds with every round it sits unrepaid, and The Hippocrate is still on the horizon.
zh_CN: 议政会警告过，借来的混沌每拖欠一回合便复利增长，而"希波克拉底"仍远在天际。

keys: Scroll of Chaos: +20% chaos now, +3% every round.
en: Scroll of Chaos: +20% chaos now, +3% every round.
zh_CN: 混沌卷轴：当前混沌 +20%，每回合 +3%。

keys: The quartermaster's ledger breeds on itself; each round the Greycoats turn in more, and the line grows fatter.
en: The quartermaster's ledger breeds on itself; each round the Greycoats turn in more, and the line grows fatter.
zh_CN: 军需官的账册会自我繁殖；每一回合灰袍兵上缴得更多，进项也越发肥厚。

keys: Scar over scar, the way a Warden's plating thickens every round the Relief fails to arrive.
en: Scar over scar, the way a Warden's plating thickens every round the Relief fails to arrive.
zh_CN: 疤上添疤，正如援军每一回合不至，卫士的装甲就增厚一层。

keys: Blessed Armor: +10 armor now, +5 every round.
en: Blessed Armor: +10 armor now, +5 every round.
zh_CN: 祝福护甲：当前护甲 +10，每回合 +5。

keys: Warden marksmanship doctrine, the kind drilled into gunners told to make every single shot count.
en: Warden marksmanship doctrine, the kind drilled into gunners told to make every single shot count.
zh_CN: 卫士的射术信条，专为那些被要求把每一发都打中的射手反复操练。

keys: Foundry overpressure tuning meant for the crater-makers, ground for walls and the crowds behind them.
en: Foundry overpressure tuning meant for the crater-makers, ground for walls and the crowds behind them.
zh_CN: 铸造厂为造坑者调校的超压设定，磨砺以对付城墙及其身后的人群。

keys: Greycoat volley discipline, salvaged off a unit that fired in ranks until the ranks ran out.
en: Greycoat volley discipline, salvaged off a unit that fired in ranks until the ranks ran out.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵的齐射纪律，扒自一支成排开火、直到排不出人为止的部队。

keys: A Hexwright field-binding that thickens whatever the tank pulses out into the ring of dirt around it.
en: A Hexwright field-binding that thickens whatever the tank pulses out into the ring of dirt around it.
zh_CN: 一道符文匠的场域束缚，把坦克脉冲到周身泥圈里的一切都加厚。

keys: Calibration recovered from the Ashmark breakwalls, meant to shove a whole front rank into the next world.
en: Calibration recovered from the Ashmark breakwalls, meant to shove a whole front rank into the next world.
zh_CN: 从艾什马克破墙处回收的校准，意在把一整排前锋推进下一个世界。

keys: Foundry ricochet-work, each hop tuned to land angrier than the last off scrap nobody else would salvage.
en: Foundry ricochet-work, each hop tuned to land angrier than the last off scrap nobody else would salvage.
zh_CN: 铸造厂的跳弹手艺，用没人愿捡的废料调校，每一跳都落得比上一跳更暴怒。

keys: Warden close-line doctrine, where the work is done at knife-reach and the gunner smells what he kills.
en: Warden close-line doctrine, where the work is done at knife-reach and the gunner smells what he kills.
zh_CN: 卫士的近线信条，活计在刀锋可及处完成，射手闻得到自己杀的东西。

keys: A long-glass sighting kit off an Ashmark sniper-nest, for killing them before they have a face.
en: A long-glass sighting kit off an Ashmark sniper-nest, for killing them before they have a face.
zh_CN: 从艾什马克狙击巢取下的长镜瞄准套件，趁敌人还没成形就把它们干掉。

keys: The Foundry's cheapest overruns, the junk the Greycoats are handed first, made to earn twice its serial.
en: The Foundry's cheapest overruns, the junk the Greycoats are handed first, made to earn twice its serial.
zh_CN: 铸造厂最便宜的过剩货，灰袍兵最先领到的破烂，被调教成赚回两倍序列号的本事。
工程升级：普通品质武器伤害翻倍。

keys: Warden execution drill: a thing on the ground and stunned is a thing the line stops counting.
en: Warden execution drill: a thing on the ground and stunned is a thing the line stops counting.
zh_CN: 卫士的处决操典：一个倒地又被眩晕的东西，就是防线不再计数的东西。
重击：对被眩晕的敌人伤害 +20%。

keys: Finish what the field-rations and the rot already started in them.
en: Finish what the field-rations and the rot already started in them.
zh_CN: 把野战口粮和腐烂已经在它们体内开了头的活儿做完。
腐蚀剧毒：对中毒目标伤害 +25%。

keys: Greycoat sickness spread through Ashmark in the bad winters; the Conclave learned to concentrate it.
en: Greycoat sickness spread through Ashmark in the bad winters; the Conclave learned to concentrate it.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵的瘟病在严冬里传遍了艾什马克；议政会学会了把它浓缩。
强效剧毒：施加的中毒伤害 +10%。

keys: A Hexwright lock that holds the stunned a breath longer, long enough for the Wardens to work.
en: A Hexwright lock that holds the stunned a breath longer, long enough for the Wardens to work.
zh_CN: 一道符文匠的锁，把被眩晕者多按住一口气的工夫，刚够卫士动手。
昏眩眩晕：眩晕持续时间 +50%。

keys: Field-improvised cruelty: Ashmark scrap-iron driven point-out into the tank's hull, set so the swing that lands draws a little back.
en: Field-improvised cruelty: Ashmark scrap-iron driven point-out into the tank's hull, set so the swing that lands draws a little back.
zh_CN: 战地临时拼凑的残忍：艾什马克的废铁尖头朝外钉进坦克舱体，落在它身上的每一击都会被回敬一点。
恐惧魔王之牙：受击时反伤 +80。

keys: A denser hide of welded scrap, the kind a Warden bolts on when reaching the tank should cost a limb.
en: A denser hide of welded scrap, the kind a Warden bolts on when reaching the tank should cost a limb.
zh_CN: 一层焊接废料堆出的更密厚皮，卫士想让靠近坦克的代价是一条肢体时就拴上它。

keys: The same improvised barbs, ground keener by a gunner with nothing left to do but sharpen the punishment.
en: The same improvised barbs, ground keener by a gunner with nothing left to do but sharpen the punishment.
zh_CN: 还是那些临时倒刺，被一个除了磨利惩罚再无事可做的射手磨得更尖。

keys: Every round the war drags on, the Wardens hammer fresh scrap into the hull and the welcome gets crueler.
en: Every round the war drags on, the Wardens hammer fresh scrap into the hull and the welcome gets crueler.
zh_CN: 战争每多拖一回合，卫士就往舱体里锤进新的废料，迎客之礼也愈发残忍。

keys: A Hexwright marking-rite that opens the flesh of everything near; the marked do not heal what is opened.
en: A Hexwright marking-rite that opens the flesh of everything near; the marked do not heal what is opened.
zh_CN: 一道符文匠的标记仪式，剖开附近一切的血肉；被标记者无法愈合那道被剖开的伤。
易伤图腾：附近敌人每秒承受伤害 +5%。

keys: The Relief never came, so the Wardens took their mending off the dying and bolted fresh plate while they were at it.
en: The Relief never came, so the Wardens took their mending off the dying and bolted fresh plate while they were at it.
zh_CN: 援军始终没来，于是卫士把治愈从垂死者身上拿走，顺手又拴上了新的装甲板。

keys: Mask of Death: +1000 max HP, +15 HP per kill.
en: Mask of Death: +1000 max HP, +15 HP per kill.
zh_CN: 死亡面具：最大生命 +1000，每次击杀 +15 生命。

keys: A deeper draught of the same grim arithmetic, each corpse on the line paying back the Relief's debt.
en: A deeper draught of the same grim arithmetic, each corpse on the line paying back the Relief's debt.
zh_CN: 同一道冷酷算术更深的一饮，防线上每具尸体都在偿还援军的欠债。

keys: +60 HP each time an enemy dies.
en: +60 HP each time an enemy dies.
zh_CN: 每当一名敌人死亡 +60 生命。

keys: Conclave rot-spores feed two mouths at once, the dying enemy's and the gunner the Relief abandoned.
en: Conclave rot-spores feed two mouths at once, the dying enemy's and the gunner the Relief abandoned.
zh_CN: 议政会的腐孢同时喂养两张嘴：垂死的敌人，和被援军抛弃的射手。

keys: Reanimating Poison: +5 HP every poison tick.
en: Reanimating Poison: +5 HP every poison tick.
zh_CN: 复生剧毒：每次中毒跳动 +5 生命。

keys: Three flips of a Greycoat token, and the quartermaster's ledger pays out in triplicate before anyone checks the column twice.
en: Three flips of a Greycoat token, and the quartermaster's ledger pays out in triplicate before anyone checks the column twice.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵的代币翻三下，军需官的账册就在没人复核那一栏之前付出了三份。

keys: Multiplication Gems: next common yields 3 copies.
en: Multiplication Gems: next common yields 3 copies.
zh_CN: 增殖宝石：下一件普通品质产出 3 份。

keys: The Conclave keeps a second of everything worth having, off the ledger and out of the quartermaster's count.
en: The Conclave keeps a second of everything worth having, off the ledger and out of the quartermaster's count.
zh_CN: 凡是值得拥有的，议政会都留一份备份，不入账册，不计军需官的数。

keys: Duplicator: next rare bought yields 1 free copy.
en: Duplicator: next rare bought yields 1 free copy.
zh_CN: 复制器：下一件购买的稀有品额外免费产出 1 份。

keys: A name in the right margin of the ledger, and the Greycoats look the other way once.
en: A name in the right margin of the ledger, and the Greycoats look the other way once.
zh_CN: 账册右栏写上一个名字，灰袍兵就睁一只眼闭一只眼一回。

keys: Black Market: next uncommon purchase is free.
en: Black Market: next uncommon purchase is free.
zh_CN: 黑市：下一次购买的非凡品质免费。

keys: Coin the Greycoats buried at Ashmark before the line broke, dug up and still drawing interest.
en: Coin the Greycoats buried at Ashmark before the line broke, dug up and still drawing interest.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵在防线崩溃前埋于艾什马克的金币，挖出来时仍在生息。
魔法宝藏：当前金币 +250，每回合收入 +5。

keys: The Wardens buried this rite with their last chaplain; it answers once, and resents being asked.
en: The Wardens buried this rite with their last chaplain; it answers once, and resents being asked.
zh_CN: 卫士把这道仪式和最后一位随军牧师一同葬下；它只应答一次，且厌恶被请求。

keys: Ankh of Reconstruction: revive once, +2000 max HP.
en: Ankh of Reconstruction: revive once, +2000 max HP.
zh_CN: 重构生命符：复活一次，最大生命 +2000。

keys: What field-dressing the Wardens have left, doled out by a surgeon who stopped counting the dead at Ashmark.
en: What field-dressing the Wardens have left, doled out by a surgeon who stopped counting the dead at Ashmark.
zh_CN: 卫士剩下的那点战地包扎，由一位在艾什马克停止清点死者的军医分发。

keys: Healing Hand: +25% to all healing received.
en: Healing Hand: +25% to all healing received.
zh_CN: 治愈之手：受到的所有治疗 +25%。

keys: Hexwright greenwood grown through the hull, more wall and slower mending the closer to death the gunner runs.
en: Hexwright greenwood grown through the hull, more wall and slower mending the closer to death the gunner runs.
zh_CN: 贯穿舱体生长的符文匠青木，射手越逼近死亡，它就越像墙、愈合得越缓。

keys: Living Wood: +2000 max HP, 1.5% missing HP/sec.
en: Living Wood: +2000 max HP, 1.5% missing HP/sec.
zh_CN: 活木：最大生命 +2000，每秒回复已损生命的 1.5%。

keys: Every Warden bow racked beside this one lends its draw to the next; the whole rack of them sights truer for the hoard.
en: Every Warden bow racked beside this one lends its draw to the next; the whole rack of them sights truer for the hoard.
zh_CN: 架在它旁边的每一张卫士弓都把拉力借给下一张；整架弓因这囤积而瞄得更准。

keys: Enchanted Moon Arrow: +100% piercing, +1% per Bow.
en: Enchanted Moon Arrow: +100% piercing, +1% per Bow.
zh_CN: 附魔月之箭：穿刺 +100%，每拥有一张弓 +1%。

keys: Ranged together, Foundry mortars find the old Ashmark firing tables faster, each barrel correcting the last.
en: Ranged together, Foundry mortars find the old Ashmark firing tables faster, each barrel correcting the last.
zh_CN: 成列排开时，铸造厂的迫击炮更快找回古老的艾什马克射表，每一门修正上一门。
精炼炸药：攻城 +100%，每拥有一门迫击炮 +1%。

keys: Feed the Foundry's worst machine more of its own kind and the chaos in it deepens with the count.
en: Feed the Foundry's worst machine more of its own kind and the chaos in it deepens with the count.
zh_CN: 给铸造厂最糟的机器喂更多同类，它体内的混沌就随数量加深。
每拥有一台死亡引擎，混沌 +10%。

keys: The Greycoats will buy the meat off a living Warden, and the ledger never asks why the line went thin.
en: The Greycoats will buy the meat off a living Warden, and the ledger never asks why the line went thin.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵连活卫士身上的肉也照买，账册从不问防线为何越来越薄。
贤者之石：最大生命 -1000，金币 +2000。

keys: Stop the surgeon's work, sell the bandages, and pay the quartermaster in the healing you'll never get.
en: Stop the surgeon's work, sell the bandages, and pay the quartermaster in the healing you'll never get.
zh_CN: 叫停军医，卖掉绷带，用你永远得不到的治愈去付给军需官。
诅咒宝藏：生命再生 -100，金币 +5000。

keys: The Greycoats price the dead by the wound; every hundred you open is a coin in the ledger.
en: The Greycoats price the dead by the wound; every hundred you open is a coin in the ledger.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵按伤口给死者定价；你每剖开一百点，账册上就多一枚金币。
每造成 100 点伤害 +1 金币。

keys: A richer contract from the same bloody ledger, paying out every twenty points of ruin you deal.
en: A richer contract from the same bloody ledger, paying out every twenty points of ruin you deal.
zh_CN: 同一本血账上更丰厚的一纸合约，你每造成二十点毁伤便结一笔。
每造成 20 点伤害 +1 金币。

keys: The Hexwrights tithe a quarter of your takings into borrowed math, keeping the skin paid up.
en: The Hexwrights tithe a quarter of your takings into borrowed math, keeping the skin paid up.
zh_CN: 符文匠把你收入的四分之一抽作什一税投入借来的算术，让那层外皮始终付清欠款。

keys: Income tops up your mana shield, 25%.
en: Income tops up your mana shield, 25%.
zh_CN: 收入为你的法力护盾充能，25%。

keys: Conclave shieldwork that studies the siege as it stands, thickening a little more each round it endures.
en: Conclave shieldwork that studies the siege as it stands, thickening a little more each round it endures.
zh_CN: 议政会的护盾手艺，边守边研究这场围城，每熬过一回合就加厚一分。

keys: A patched plate off an Ashmark casualty, just enough give before the seam parts.
en: A patched plate off an Ashmark casualty, just enough give before the seam parts.
zh_CN: 从艾什马克一名伤亡者身上补来的甲板，接缝绷裂前刚好能让你喘口气。

keys: A spare Warden quiver, the heads honed on the same stone the last gunner used.
en: A spare Warden quiver, the heads honed on the same stone the last gunner used.
zh_CN: 一只备用的卫士箭袋，箭头是在上一名射手用过的同一块磨石上磨利的。

keys: Plain Foundry shot, no markings, no cleverness, stamped out by the crate.
en: Plain Foundry shot, no markings, no cleverness, stamped out by the crate.
zh_CN: 朴素的铸造厂弹丸，无标记，无花巧，成箱地冲压出来。
强化普通攻击：普通伤害 +10%。

keys: A Foundry overrun of siege charges, serialed for a wall at Ashmark that no longer stands.
en: A Foundry overrun of siege charges, serialed for a wall at Ashmark that no longer stands.
zh_CN: 铸造厂过剩的攻城炸药，编号对应艾什马克一堵早已不复存在的城墙。

keys: Conclave ordnance the Hexwrights signed for but never logged, full of something that resents the barrel.
en: Conclave ordnance the Hexwrights signed for but never logged, full of something that resents the barrel.
zh_CN: 符文匠签收却从未登记的议政会军械，里头满是憎恶枪管的东西。
强化混沌攻击：混沌伤害 +10%。

keys: Hull plating cut from a dead Ashmark engine, bolted over the old wounds.
en: Hull plating cut from a dead Ashmark engine, bolted over the old wounds.
zh_CN: 从一台报废的艾什马克引擎上割下的舱体装甲，拴在旧伤之上。

keys: A Foundry armor ration, thin but stamped and accounted for in the ledger.
en: A Foundry armor ration, thin but stamped and accounted for in the ledger.
zh_CN: 一份铸造厂的护甲配给，虽薄却盖了章、记了账。

keys: Heavy Warden plate pulled off a tank that held this line three reliefs ago.
en: Heavy Warden plate pulled off a tank that held this line three reliefs ago.
zh_CN: 从一辆三次援军之前还守着这条防线的坦克上拆下的卫士重甲。

keys: The Greycoats run the corpse-tally generous when the bodies pile this high.
en: The Greycoats run the corpse-tally generous when the bodies pile this high.
zh_CN: 当尸体堆到这般高，灰袍兵清点起来便慷慨了。

keys: A Hexwright recharging-rite for the borrowed skin, drawing the pool back up a quarter faster than it bleeds.
en: A Hexwright recharging-rite for the borrowed skin, drawing the pool back up a quarter faster than it bleeds.
zh_CN: 为那层借来外皮准备的符文匠充能仪式，把储量回灌得比它流失快四分之一。

keys: A standing line in the quartermaster's ledger, paid out of Ashmark salvage each round.
en: A standing line in the quartermaster's ledger, paid out of Ashmark salvage each round.
zh_CN: 军需官账册上一笔固定条目，每回合从艾什马克的回收物中支取。

keys: A scrap of Foundry plate, half a ration, glancing off what it can.
en: A scrap of Foundry plate, half a ration, glancing off what it can.
zh_CN: 一小块铸造厂甲板，半份配给，能挡则挡。

keys: A Foundry gear-kit that shaves the pause between firings, cut from a faster machine.
en: A Foundry gear-kit that shaves the pause between firings, cut from a faster machine.
zh_CN: 一套铸造厂齿轮组，削减两次击发之间的停顿，取自一台更快的机器。

keys: The Wardens' field-surgeon at full pace, stitching faster than the line falls apart, and faster still as the wounds mount.
en: The Wardens' field-surgeon at full pace, stitching faster than the line falls apart, and faster still as the wounds mount.
zh_CN: 卫士的战地军医全速运转，缝合得比防线崩散还快，伤口越多缝得越快。

keys: A slow, stubborn mending, all the relief the Wardens could spare this post.
en: A slow, stubborn mending, all the relief the Wardens could spare this post.
zh_CN: 一种缓慢而固执的愈合，是卫士能匀给这个哨位的全部慰藉。

keys: Repair Crew: +20 HP regen per tick.
en: Repair Crew: +20 HP regen per tick.

keys: A thin trickle on the Greycoat ledger, the kind command forgets to honor.
en: A thin trickle on the Greycoat ledger, the kind command forgets to honor.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵账册上细细的一笔，正是指挥部会忘记兑现的那种。

keys: Magic Coin: +5 gold income per round.
en: Magic Coin: +5 gold income per round.
zh_CN: 魔法硬币：每回合金币收入 +5。

keys: A modest seam in the quartermaster's books, paid round on round and skimmed a margin besides.
en: A modest seam in the quartermaster's books, paid round on round and skimmed a margin besides.
zh_CN: 军需官账本里不起眼的一道矿脉，回回结付，外加揩去一层油。

keys: The Greycoats pay twice over for the same fallen, the ledger long past honesty.
en: The Greycoats pay twice over for the same fallen, the ledger long past honesty.
zh_CN: 同一名阵亡者，灰袍兵付两遍钱，这账册早已与诚实无缘。

keys: Conclave shot the Hexwrights leaned on too hard, biting back through the barrel each time.
en: Conclave shot the Hexwrights leaned on too hard, biting back through the barrel each time.
zh_CN: 符文匠用得太狠的议政会弹丸，每次都顺着枪管反咬一口。

keys: A respectable clip of mending, more than the Relief ever delivered to this line.
en: A respectable clip of mending, more than the Relief ever delivered to this line.
zh_CN: 一段相当可观的愈合，比援军给过这条防线的还多。

keys: An obscene coat of Hexwright life-work, more borrowed skin than any Warden was meant to wear, and it turns the blows it eats.
en: An obscene coat of Hexwright life-work, more borrowed skin than any Warden was meant to wear, and it turns the blows it eats.
zh_CN: 一层过分的符文匠生命之作，借来的外皮多过任何卫士本该承受的，它还能挡下吞下的打击。

keys: A Greycoat's bad habits, learned at Ashmark: one swing in ten finds only air.
en: A Greycoat's bad habits, learned at Ashmark: one swing in ten finds only air.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵在艾什马克学来的坏习惯：十下里有一下只挥到空气。

keys: The Greycoat ledger compounds as the siege drags on, the dead worth more every round The Hippocrate nears.
en: The Greycoat ledger compounds as the siege drags on, the dead worth more every round The Hippocrate nears.
zh_CN: 随围城拖延，灰袍兵的账册复利增长，"希波克拉底"每靠近一回合，死者就更值钱。

keys: Warden salvage welded round Warden salvage, the wall thickening every round the line holds.
en: Warden salvage welded round Warden salvage, the wall thickening every round the line holds.
zh_CN: 卫士回收物焊在卫士回收物外，防线每守住一回合，墙就加厚一层。

keys: A thin Hexwright coat of borrowed math, enough to spend before your own skin.
en: A thin Hexwright coat of borrowed math, enough to spend before your own skin.
zh_CN: 一层薄薄的符文匠借来算术之衣，够你在赔上自己皮肉前先花。

keys: The Wardens' last surgeon works faster the longer the war grinds, mending quickening as the siege wears on.
en: The Wardens' last surgeon works faster the longer the war grinds, mending quickening as the siege wears on.
zh_CN: 卫士最后一位军医随战事磨砺而手脚越快，围城拖得越久，愈合也越快。
每跳生命再生 +120，每回合再 +30。

keys: Foundry masons fit the old wall to a finer tolerance than the war deserves, and the thicker it stands the harder its guns hit.
en: Foundry masons fit the old wall to a finer tolerance than the war deserves, and the thicker it stands the harder its guns hit.
zh_CN: 铸造厂的石匠把旧墙修到了比这场战争配得上的更高精度，墙立得越厚，它的炮打得越狠。

keys: Mastercrafted Masonry: +5000 max HP, +1% damage per 2000 max HP.
en: Mastercrafted Masonry: +5000 max HP, +1% damage per 2000 max HP.
zh_CN: 匠造砌石：最大生命 +5000，每 2000 最大生命使伤害 +1%。

keys: A Greycoat quartermaster's signet, worn smooth on the corpse-ledger; the richer the bounty it counts, the meaner the line shoots.
en: A Greycoat quartermaster's signet, worn smooth on the corpse-ledger; the richer the bounty it counts, the meaner the line shoots.
zh_CN: 一枚灰袍兵军需官的印戒，在尸体账册上磨得发亮；它清点的赏金越丰厚，防线打得就越凶。

keys: Golden Ring: +200% kill bounty, +1% damage per 50% bounty.
en: Golden Ring: +200% kill bounty, +1% damage per 50% bounty.
zh_CN: 黄金指环：击杀赏金 +200%，每 50% 赏金使伤害 +1%。

keys: A Hexwright sigil burned into the borrowed skin; while the shield holds, every shot carries a little of that stolen fire.
en: A Hexwright sigil burned into the borrowed skin; while the shield holds, every shot carries a little of that stolen fire.
zh_CN: 一道烙进那层借来外皮的符文匠魔印；只要护盾还在，每一发都带着一点偷来的火。

keys: Arcane Mark: +4000 mana shield, +20% damage while it holds.
en: Arcane Mark: +4000 mana shield, +20% damage while it holds.
zh_CN: 奥术印记：法力护盾 +4000，护盾存在时伤害 +20%。

keys: The Conclave fed this thing on the dying and it learned to drink; each corpse on the line tops its borrowed skin back up.
en: The Conclave fed this thing on the dying and it learned to drink; each corpse on the line tops its borrowed skin back up.
zh_CN: 议政会用垂死者喂养这东西，它学会了畅饮；防线上每具尸体都把它借来的外皮回灌一截。

keys: Maw of Death: +2000 mana shield, +15 shield per enemy killed.
en: Maw of Death: +2000 mana shield, +15 shield per enemy killed.
zh_CN: 死亡之喉：法力护盾 +2000，每击杀一名敌人护盾 +15。

keys: Hexwright shielding wound so tight that when it finally fails it fails outward, a white concussion that lays the whole front rank flat.
en: Hexwright shielding wound so tight that when it finally fails it fails outward, a white concussion that lays the whole front rank flat.
zh_CN: 符文匠的护盾缠得极紧，终于失效时便向外炸开，一记白色震荡把整排前锋掀翻在地。

keys: Energy Pulse: +2000 mana shield; when it breaks, stun all enemies in 1200 for 0.5s.
en: Energy Pulse: +2000 mana shield; when it breaks, stun all enemies in 1200 for 0.5s.
zh_CN: 能量脉冲：法力护盾 +2000；破碎时，眩晕 1200 范围内所有敌人 0.5 秒。

keys: Greycoat sickness ground into the welds, so the swing that draws the tank's blood draws its own rot back.
en: Greycoat sickness ground into the welds, so the swing that draws the tank's blood draws its own rot back.
zh_CN: 灰袍兵的瘟病被磨进焊缝，于是任何放出坦克之血的一击，也会引来它自己的腐烂。

keys: Poison Armor: +10 armor, +40 spikes; retaliation also poisons.
en: Poison Armor: +10 armor, +40 spikes; retaliation also poisons.
zh_CN: 剧毒护甲：护甲 +10，尖刺 +40；反伤同时附带中毒。

keys: Each blow against the hull breaks off another barb into it; the longer the line presses, the crueler the welcome grows, until the round resets the count.
en: Each blow against the hull breaks off another barb into it; the longer the line presses, the crueler the welcome grows, until the round resets the count.
zh_CN: 每记砸向舱体的打击都会折断又一根倒刺嵌进去；前线压得越久，迎客之礼就越残忍，直到回合重置计数。

keys: Bloody Spikes: +80 spikes; retaliation stacks more damage each hit (resets each round).
en: Bloody Spikes: +80 spikes; retaliation stacks more damage each hit (resets each round).
zh_CN: 血腥尖刺：尖刺 +80；反伤每次受击叠加更多伤害（每回合重置）。

keys: A Hexwright rot-totem bolted to the tank, breathing a slow green ruin into the ground around it that the close-pressed never leave clean.
en: A Hexwright rot-totem bolted to the tank, breathing a slow green ruin into the ground around it that the close-pressed never leave clean.
zh_CN: 一根拴在坦克上的符文匠腐烂图腾，向周身土地缓缓吐出绿色的毁灭，逼近的敌人从不能干净脱身。

keys: Blight Aura: +200 regen; pulse 200 poison damage in 600 every second.
en: Blight Aura: +200 regen; pulse 200 poison damage in 600 every second.
zh_CN: 枯萎光环：再生 +200；每秒在 600 范围内脉冲 200 点中毒伤害。

en: Only the host can change game speed.
zh_CN: 只有主机可以更改游戏速度。

en: Overwhelmed by %s ×%d — took %s damage in the final 10 s
zh_CN: 被 %s ×%d 淹没——最后 10 秒承受 %s 伤害

keys: Tip: enemy waves scale every round (and jump +20% at 10:00) — buy HP, armor and regen so the ramp doesn't outpace you.
en: Tip: enemy waves scale every round (and jump +20% at 10:00) — buy HP, armor and regen so the ramp doesn't outpace you.
zh_CN: 提示：敌潮每轮都在增强（10:00 更猛增 +20%）——购买生命、护甲与回复，别被强度曲线甩开。

keys: Tip: the shop closes for good at 15:00 when the boss arrives — spend your gold before the bell.
en: Tip: the shop closes for good at 15:00 when the boss arrives — spend your gold before the bell.
zh_CN: 提示：15:00 首领登场时商店将永久关闭——赶在钟声前把金币花掉。

keys: Tip: Clear [Space] is the only thing that hurts the boss — keep it off cooldown once the boss is up.
en: Tip: Clear [Space] is the only thing that hurts the boss — keep it off cooldown once the boss is up.
zh_CN: 提示：清场 [Space] 是唯一能伤到首领的手段——首领现身后要掐好冷却。

keys: Tip: every shop slot rolls independently — rarity odds are 50/30/15/5, so an epic on the board is a rare treat.
en: Tip: every shop slot rolls independently — rarity odds are 50/30/15/5, so an epic on the board is a rare treat.
zh_CN: 提示：商店每个栏位独立随机——稀有度概率为 50/30/15/5，牌面上出现史诗实属难得。

keys: Tip: free rerolls bank up and never expire — spend them freely when the board is bad.
en: Tip: free rerolls bank up and never expire — spend them freely when the board is bad.
zh_CN: 提示：免费重投可以攒着且永不过期——牌面不好就放心用。

keys: Tip: damage types matter — piercing, siege and magic each punish different armor, and the typed +25% upgrades compound.
en: Tip: damage types matter — piercing, siege and magic each punish different armor, and the typed +25% upgrades compound.
zh_CN: 提示：伤害类型很重要——穿刺、攻城、魔法各克不同护甲，对应的 +25% 强化收益还会叠加。

keys: Tip: economy compounds — income early snowballs into weapons late; pure greed and pure guns are both risky.
en: Tip: economy compounds — income early snowballs into weapons late; pure greed and pure guns are both risky.
zh_CN: 提示：经济会滚雪球——前期攒收入，后期换武器；纯贪金和纯火力都有风险。

keys: Tip: Deep Freeze is an upgrade — without it 25 Frost stacks never freeze; with it, frozen enemies take +50% damage.
en: Tip: Deep Freeze is an upgrade — without it 25 Frost stacks never freeze; with it, frozen enemies take +50% damage.
zh_CN: 提示：深度冻结是一件强化——没有它，25 层冰霜也不会冻结；有了它，冻结的敌人多受 50% 伤害。

en: This run is still live — restarting abandons it.
zh_CN: 本局仍在进行中——重新开始将放弃这局。

en: Your rivals keep fighting — a live net match never pauses.
zh_CN: 你的对手仍在战斗——联网对局永不暂停。
